reasons.contains_personal_attack: The comment directly insults the target player and demands they quit and never return, matching the rules ban on personal attacks despite a banter history.
reasons.moderation_action: A personal attack is likely, but prior mutual banter, mutual follows, low threat score, and no report from the target make a single removal the best fit with hide-for-review and remove-plus-warn as close alternatives.
reasons.classifier_agreement: The insult and toxicity scores track the plainly insulting text reasonably well, though the low threat score understates the exclusionary demand, so agreement is clear rather than total.
